item.title: learning and teaching partner dance progression
item.description: Low lofi to high fi. Basic pattern solo x1 Basic pattern solo x2 Basic pattern solo x4 To music, solo x1, x2, x4, x8 With a partner, in open, x1, x2, x4, (x8) do x1 to x3 times with each partner before calling rotate With a partner, in open, to music, x1, x2, x4, (x8) do x1 to x3 times with each partner before calling rotate Each item in this progression contains multiple skills beyond just doing the pattern.
